title: A multiphysics computational framework for evaluating ATP response and thermal loading during skeletal muscle photobiomodulation

title: CFD investigation of a novel gabion-based porous medium configuration for energy dissipation in ogee spillway stilling basins
task: CFD investigation of gabion-based porous media for energy dissipation in ogee spillway stilling basins
key_results: Uniform gabions achieve ~65% improvement in relative energy dissipation vs. smooth-bed; downstream Froude reduction of 91–98%
comments: Computational fluid dynamics simulation study; gabion porous media offer cost-effective alternative to concrete basins with significant hydraulic efficiency.

model_io.model: CFD simulation with uniform and cross-shaped gabion configurations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gabion-based porous media improve energy dissipation vs. smooth-bed
hypotheses.result: Uniform gabions: 65% improvement; cross-shaped: 46% improvement

title: Numerical study of scattering and polarisation characteristics of marine spherical aerosol particles illuminated by non-diffracting Tricomi beams
task: Study scattering and polarization of marine aerosol particles illuminated by non-diffracting Tricomi beams
key_results: Scattering intensity enhanced by increasing aerosol radius or topological charge; humidity-induced marine aerosol composition significantly modulates scattering amplitude and relative polarization response
comments: Generalized Lorenz–Mie calculations are rigorous, but experimental validation in actual maritime environments and practical optical communication performance remain unexplored.

model_io.model: Generalized Lorenz–Mie theory with Tricomi beam shape coefficients
inputs: Tricomi beam (topological charge, asymmetry parameters, half-cone angle)
spherical aerosol radius and refractive index

hypotheses.hypothesis: Beam configuration parameters (topological charge, asymmetry) allow control over scattering response
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—scattering and polarization can be precisely tuned by beam parameters and aerosol properties

hypotheses.hypothesis: Marine humidity significantly affects scattering and polarization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—humidity-induced changes in aerosol composition produce significant modulation of scattering amplitude and polarization

title: An optimized majority-feedback QCA D-latch and SET/RESET-enabled SRAM cell for compact, low-latency nanoelectronic memory design
task: Design compact, low-latency QCA D-latch and SRAM memory cells
key_results: 14-cell QCA D-latch with 0.007 µm² footprint reduces area/latency/cost vs. prior designs; 15-cell SET/RESET variant reduces peak energy dissipation by ~22%
comments: Simulation-only results in QCA Designer; actual fabrication feasibility and temperature robustness of QCA devices remain open practical challenges.

model_io.model: QCA circuit simulation (QCA Designer 2.0.3 and QCAPro)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single-layer majority-feedback D-latch architecture reduces area and latency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—14-cell design achieves 0.007 µm² footprint with improved performance vs. literature

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adding SET/RESET control increases peak energy dissipation
hypotheses.result: Rejected—15-cell variant reduces peak energy by ~22% relative to 14-cell baseline

title: Intertwined bulk photocarrier and interfacial barrier dynamics in van der Waals point-contact Schottky junctions
task: Resolve nanoscale spatiotemporal dynamics of bulk photocarriers and interfacial barriers in WSe₂/PtIr Schottky junctions
key_results: OPP-TR-AFM reveals intertwined hole diffusion (governed by bulk trap occupancy) and thermionic emission (modulated by surface photovoltage); pronounced nanoscale spatial variations in coupled dynamics
comments: Novel time-resolved AFM methodology elegantly decouples bulk and interface effects, though generalization to other vdW materials and quantitative device performance implications need exploration.

model_io.model: Optical pump–probe time-resolved AFM (OPP-TR-AFM) + transient absorption spectroscopy + numerical simulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Photocarrier response is dominated by a single mechanism (bulk diffusion or thermionic emission)
hypotheses.result: Rejected—response explained by competition between long-lived hole diffusion and thermionic emission with spatially varying coupling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Interfacial barrier dynamics can be resolved simultaneously with bulk carrier transport at nanoscale resolution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—OPP-TR-AFM spatially maps coupled dynamics with simultaneous temporal resolution
